title: Y1DA--544-355 Construct Behavioral Health Center of Excellence (VA-26-00069876)
description: INTRODUCTION: This Sources Sought Notice is for market research and information purposes only at this time and shall not be construed as a solicitation or as an obligation on the part of the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). The Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Program Contracting Activity Central (PCAC) is conducting a market survey and is seeking potential sources for the Construct Behavioral Health Center of Excellence Construction project at the Wm. Jennings Bryan Dorn Department of Veterans Affairs Medical Center located in Columbia, SC. PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The intent of the project is to construct a new single story, 15,756 gross square foot (GSF) outpatient behavioral health center at the William Jennings Bryan Dorn VA Medical Center located in Columbia, SC. This project will meet the rising demand of medical intervention in an enhanced therapeutic patient centered environment for behavioral health services to include confidential access to professional care, self-help programs, interactive tools and educational resources to help Veterans with life s changes and challenges. This project will include but is not limited to new construction, mechanical, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, low-voltage, fire protection, fire alarm, utility work, interior finishes, utility coordination, site work, structural, landscaping, underground storm retention,(storm water management systems), asbestos and lead survey abatement where present in areas of the existing hospital and communication utility work inside an active hospital. All tie-ins to existing VA utilities (telecom-fire alarm, electrical etc.) shall be coordinated in advance to avoid service disruptions. PROCUREMENT INFORMATION: The proposed project will be a competitive, firm-fixed-price contract utilizing the design-bid-build approach (Final Specifications and Drawings will be provided). The anticipated solicitation will be issued either as a Request For Proposal (RFP) in accordance with FAR Part 15, considering Technical and Price Factors or as an Invitation for Bid (IFB) in accordance with FAR Part 14, considering Price only. The results and analysis of the market research will finalize the determination of the procurement method. The type of socio-economic set-aside, if any, will depend upon the responses to this notice and any other information gathered during the market research process. This project is planned for advertising in early - October 2026. In accordance with VAAR 836.204, the magnitude of construction is between $10,000,000.00 and $20,000,000.00. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 236220 (size standard $45.0 million) applies to this procurement. The duration of the project is currently estimated at 680 calendar days from the issuance of a Notice to Proceed. The services for this project will include providing all construction related services such as providing labor, materials and equipment required to complete the project as per contract documents prepared by an independent Architect-Engineer firm. CAPABILITY STATEMENT: Respondents shall provide a general capabilities statement to include the following information: Section 1: Provide company name, Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), company address, Point-of-Contact name, phone number and email. Section 2: Provide company business size based on NAICS code 236220. Also, provide business type (i.e., Large Business, Small Business, Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business, Small Disadvantaged Business, Women-Owned Small Business, Hub Zone Small Business, etc.). Section 3: Provide a Statement of Interest in the project. Section 4: Provide the prime contractor s available bonding capacity in the form of a letter of intent from your bonding company with this submission. *Please ensure that the individual bonding capacity is in line with the VAAR Magnitude of Construction listed above. Section 5: Provide the type of work your company has performed in the past in support of the same or similar requirement. This section is IMPORTANT as it will help to determine the type of socio-economic set-aside, if any. Please provide the following in your response: No more than three (3) contracts that your company has performed within the last seven (7) years that are of comparable size, complexity, and scope to this requirement. Include the project name, project owner and contact information as this person may be contacted for further information, project scope, project size (Example: square footage), building use (Example: Medical Facility, Office Building, etc.), project dollar value, start and completion dates. Provide specific examples that relate aspects of previous projects to the proposed project. Describe specific technical skills and key personnel your company possess to perform the requirements described under description of work. Describe your Self-Performed** effort (as either a Prime or Subcontractor). Describe Self-Performed work in terms of dollar value and description. **Self-Performed means work performed by the offeror themselves, NOT work performed by another company for them for any of the project examples provided. It is requested that interested contractors submit a response (electronic submission) of no more than nine (9) single sided pages, single-spaced, 12-point font minimum that addresses the above information. This response must be submitted as a single application-generated (not scanned) PDF document that is less than or equal to 4MB in size. Please note that hard copies will not be accepted. Please also include a cover page, which includes, at a minimum: the company s name, address, Unique Entity Identifier (if available), socio-economic status, point-of-contact name, phone number, and e-mail address. Responses must include the Sources Sought number and project title in the subject line of their e-mail response. Submissions (responses) shall be submitted via email to the primary and secondary points of contact listed below by September 10, 2026, at 1:00 PM ET. The Capabilities Statement submitted in response to this Sources Sought shall not be considered to be a bid or proposal. This notice is for information and planning purposes only and is neither to be construed as a commitment by the Government nor will the Government pay for information solicited. No evaluation letters and/or results will be issued to the respondents. After completing its analyses, the Government will determine whether to limit competition among the small business categories listed above or proceed with full and open competition as other than small business. At this time no solicitation exists; therefore, please do not request a copy of the solicitation. If a solicitation is released it will be synopsized in Contract Opportunities at https://sam.gov/. It is the potential offeror's responsibility to monitor this site for the release of any solicitation or synopsis. title: Electrical Rebuild, Black Rock Lake Dam, Thomaston, Connecticut
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, New England District is solicitating an Invitation for Bids (IFB) for Electrical Feeder Upgrades at the Black Rock Lake Dam in Thomaston, Connecticut. This will be a 100% Small Business Set-Aside IFB procurement. The NAICS code for the work described below is 238210 with a size standard of $19M. The project is planned to be issued in July 2026 and will be set aside for Small Businesses. The period of performance will be approximately 180 days. The estimated magnitude of this project is between $750,000 and $1,250,000.The work of this project involves electrical feeder upgrades at the Black Rock Lake Dam in Thomaston, Connecticut. Specific work tasks include, but are not limited to, replacing the existing overhead dam feeder (which runs underneath a high voltage line) from the project office to a designated manhole with a buried conduit duct bank.The existing gate tower feeder is in an existing buried duct bank which runs up the dam face and in exposed conduit beneath the gate tower bridge will be removed and replaced with new. The fused disconnect at the existing overhead line end will be removed. The existing manual transfer switches in the gate tower and project office will be removed. The existing 480V Panel-A, transformer, and 120/208 Panel-B in the gate tower will be removed and replaced with new. The existing service entrance circuit breaker and its enclosure will remain and be reused. Install new propane genset in the project office parking lot. Install a new propane tank with an underground propane line connected to the genset. The new genset will be sized to power both the project office and the gate tower on loss of utility. The propane tank will be sized to provide 5 days of run time before needing to be refilled. Install a new properly sized automatic transfer switch to feed existing panel MDP-1 from either the existing utility feeder or the new propane genset.

title: Video Game Purchase Plan

title: Class 5 IPS - Presolicitation Notice
description: The 87th Contracting Squadron intends to award a sole source contract to Trusted Systems, Inc., located at 2920 Dede Rd, Suite A, Finksburg, MD 21048, under the authority of RFO 6.103-1, Only One Responsible Source. The 87th Communications Squadron requires the procurement, delivery, and physical installation of one Class 5 Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) container and associated SIPRGuard accessories to provide secure housing and mass management of SIPRNet devices in Building 2320, Room 101, Joint Base MDL, NJ. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals, and no solicitation document exists for this requirement at this time. Sources that believe they can meet this requirement are invited to submit a capability statement, including technical data and cost information, in sufficient detail and with convincing evidence to clearly demonstrate the capability to provide the required hardware, software, and installation services described below. Capability statements shall not exceed 5 (8.5 x 11inch) pages, using a font size no smaller than 10-point. All capability statements received by the closing date of this notice will be considered by the Government. A request for additional information, or a submission that only asks questions, will not be considered an affirmative response. A determination by the Government not to compete this requirement based on responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will be used solely to determine whether to conduct a competitive procurement or to proceed with a sole source award. The following is a statement of the contractor's unique qualifications and why the nature of this acquisition requires use of the authority cited above: Trusted Systems, Inc. is the manufacturer and sole GSA-authorized source, per the applicable GSA Qualified Products List (QPL) and Direct Purchase Authority (DPA) No. 2026-08-2835, for the TSM621FWX-SC Class 5 IPS Container required under this acquisition. GSA-approved Class 5 security containers of this type may only be purchased from the manufacturer identified on the QPL for that specific model; no other source is authorized to sell or install this item. In addition, the required SIPRGuard gateway modules, manual control module, and associated TrustedCare maintenance plans are proprietary products designed, manufactured, and supported exclusively by Trusted Systems, Inc., and are not available from any other source. Based on market research, there is reasonable evidence that Trusted Systems, Inc. is the only responsible source capable of furnishing this equipment and its associated installation and maintenance without substantial duplication of cost to the Government that could not be expected to be recovered through competition, and without unacceptable delay in fulfilling the 87th Communications Squadron's requirement. IAW RFO 5.101(c), the following information is provided: Points of Contact. A1C Theodore C.M. Hyatt, Contracting Specialist, 87 Contracting Squadron/PKB, 2402 Vandenberg Avenue, Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst, NJ 08641; Email: theodore.hyatt@us.af.mil Lizbette Zalybniuk, Contracting Officer, 87 Contracting Squadron/PKB, 2402 Vandenberg Avenue, Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst, NJ 08641; Email: lizbette.zalybniuk.1@us.af.mil Set-Asides. This acquisition is being set aside for 100% small business RFO Part 19. Codes for Services or Supplies. Product Service Code (PSC): 7110. North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code: 332999, All Other Miscellaneous Fabricated Metal Product Manufacturing. Description. The requirement is for the procurement, delivery, and physical installation of one (1) Trusted Systems, Inc. TSM621FWX-SC Class 5 IPS (Intrusion Prevention System) security container, together with associated internal components, cabling, power distribution units, and SIPRGuard gateway modules, to be installed within Building 2320, Room 101, Joint Base MDL, NJ. The container is a GSA-approved Class 5 security enclosure used to physically protect classified network devices (routers, switches, and hubs) on the SIPRNet in accordance with applicable DISA STIG physical protection requirements. Associated deliverables include an enlarged cable box, laptop slide trays, rack-mount power distribution units and cording, SIPRGuard dual KVME gateway and Ethernet gateway modules, a SIPRGuard manual control module with DM bypass, rack-mount shelving and cable management hardware, an integrated IPS drop box, keystone feed-through and coupler hardware, CAT6 patch cabling, HDMI and USB cabling, and three (3) years of TrustedCare maintenance coverage for the gateway and manual control modules. The scope also includes system-level configuration of the SIPRGuard baseline, functional testing, and support for Government user acceptance testing. The scope excludes logical configuration of network switches or existing infrastructure beyond the direct physical installation of the procured equipment. The estimated period of performance is 180 days from contract award. The Government will evaluate any capability statements received by the closing date below to confirm whether Trusted Systems, Inc. remains the only responsible source. If no responsive capability statement demonstrates that another source can meet the requirement, the Government intends to proceed with a sole source award to Trusted Systems, Inc. using simplified acquisition procedures under RFO Part 12. The anticipated award date is on or about 11 September 2026. IAW RFO 5.101, Table 5-2, this pre-solicitation notice will be posted for a minimum of 15 days. Responses are due by 1:00 PM Eastern Time, 10 September 2026. Responses shall be submitted by email only, as a Microsoft Word or Adobe PDF attachment, to the following addresses: theodore.hyatt@us.af.mil and lizbette.zalybniuk.1@us.af.mil.

The mitigation consists of installing bank armoring with rip rap, and placing sub grade aggregate along the trail. The sub grade aggregate (3� minus) is to be placed as backfill behind the riprap and is incidental to item 201501A. Backfill quantities will vary but the end product is to have ~2-4 ft of 3� minus behind the placed riprap. The D-1 aggregate is to be placed on the trail running surface to harden the trail for ATV use. The majority of trail 229 is 6 to 8 feet in width and will require additional clearing and minor excavation depending on type of equipment used. Construction must occur during low water times of year, diversion of smaller channels within the project location will be needed to dewater bank locations. Small diversion for bank armoring is assumed to be conducted with either a dozer or excavator that may operate in the stream channel or along the stream bank. Work must be performed when there is 5 consecutive days below 30F degrees are reached This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 237990 Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. The small business size standard is $45,000,000.00 This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency.
